name: Block Climbing
summary:
Climb your way through 30 unique indoor levels packed with ice axes, breakable grips, ropes, and plenty of surprises. Some walls invite you to become the route architect: place new grips with the grip pistol or even shift entire wall sections to design your own path to the top.

Push your speed, uncover hidden shortcuts, and race against player ghostss. The fastest runs are showcased on blockclimbingvr.com, where you can compare your achievements and see how your climbs stack up against the best.
